title: Managed-Spend Relief on Network and Server Order Deposits
content:
**Relief schedule.** Managed-spend relief points come off the infrastructure deposit percentage, the percentage at which the deposit on the approval of a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote is taken, by the client's monthly ClearPath seat billing, the amount of the latest ClearPath monthly fee posted on its ClearPath billing while it holds an active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement, measured against the quote total:

- **5.0 points** when that monthly billing is at least **0.5** times the quote total;
- **2.0 points** when it is at least **0.25** times the quote total and less than 0.5 times it;
- none for a lower monthly billing or no active ClearPath agreement.

The monthly billing is the amount of the most recently posted monthly fee entry on the client's ClearPath billing ledger; a client without an active ClearPath agreement has no monthly billing for this purpose.

## Bands, worked (hypothetical quote total of 8000.00)

| Latest ClearPath monthly fee | Against the quote total | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 4000.00 | exactly 0.5 times | 5.0 points |
| 3999.99 | at least 0.25, less than 0.5 times | 2.0 points |
| 2000.00 | exactly 0.25 times | 2.0 points |
| 1999.99 | less than 0.25 times | none |
| any amount, but no active agreement | | none |
